response.rationale: Alien Worm adds +3 max HP and +2 HP regen, both weighted in the plan (7 and 5). The run is fragile early at 16 HP, so survival stats fit the difficulty-1 goal. Its consumable-heal penalty is a minor cost.

Laser Gun is ranged, piercing, 40 base damage with strong ranged scaling, and fits the all-ranged plan. Medical Gun is also ranged and adds HP regen set bonus. Both fit at 64 gold. Decline melee Goat Skull and Gentle Alien (more enemies hurts survival).
Armor has the top advisor score (7) and matches the plan's armor weight (7), above percent damage (6.5) and speed (4). Survival is the goal, and the wiki notes early collapse as the main failure.

Medical gun is ranged, scales 1.0 with ranged damage, and starts a Medical set for regen (plan weights regen 5). Price 20 leaves 28 gold. Shotgun duplicate scales weakly at 0.8. Ugly tooth slows us, so declined.

Early-wave survival is the bottleneck: 21 HP is fragile and past runs collapsed early. +3 max HP (~14%) plus regen beats a marginal +1 ranged damage at wave 3. Plan weights are close, so this follows the survival plan.
Speed is the only option in the plan's stat weights (stat_speed 4) and the only one with a positive advisor score. Melee damage is useless with a ranged kit; luck and elemental damage are off-plan.
Max HP +6 on a 26 HP base is a large survival gain, matching the plan's survival focus and the early-collapse problem. Attack speed +10 is close in plan weight, but HP is the safer pick here.

Plan weights ranged damage highest (8) and the advisor scores this 8. Melee and elemental options don't fit this ranged build. Dodge +6 is tempting, but the wiki says defence-first ran worse because kill speed matters.

Tier 3 Double Barrel is the strongest ranged, plan-aligned upgrade (4 piercing shots, range bonus) and affordable at 196 gold. Declining the melee Ghost Flint, Fuel Tank (negative ranged) and Weird Ghost (sets HP to 1 next wave).

Acid gives +8 max HP, matching the plan's max_hp weight and the survival goal. Dodge -2 is a small cost. Six weapons already held (max_weapons 6), so Taser is out. Scared Sausage adds no value for this build.

Doc Moth adds regen and lifesteal, both in the survival plan, and leaves 138 gold. Shotgun 3 would be a 7th weapon over the max of 6 and duplicates a shotgun already held. Baby Elephant's luck is off-plan at luck -5.
Free crate item with no listed downside. Doc Moth is tagged hp_regeneration and lifesteal, which fit the survival plan, and it adds a pet. No HP-drain interaction with the held items. Take it.
No offer fits. Harpoon is unaffordable. Medical Gun 2 needs a sixth weapon slot already full. Weird Ghost sets HP to 1 at wave start. Beanie cuts range 17 to 11 for a ranged kit. Keep gold.

Reinforced Steel adds +2 ranged damage and +3 engineering, the plan's top ranged-damage weight, at 122 of 261 gold. Its -3 speed is the cost. Cake is cheap max HP and approved too. Propeller Hat and Cyberball add luck, which the plan doesn't weight.
Free item with no cost. Lemonade's +1 consumable heal partly offsets the two Alien Worms' -1 consumable heal each, and survival matters at wave 13 with 95 max HP. Low impact, so take it.
Banner adds +20 range (we sit at -6) and +10 attack speed, both fitting the ranged kiting plan. Helmet adds armor for survival at low cost. Ghost Axe is melee, off-plan. Recycling is not needed.

Goblet's heal_on_kill 15 is a strong survival effect in a run with 20+ enemies per wave. The cost is -3 regen and -2 lifesteal, which hurt but are outweighed if kills happen often. Advisor score is negative, so this is close.

Melee damage is useless for this ranged plan. Plan weights attack speed 7 over speed 4. HP is full at 99 and telemetry shows no recent damage, so kill speed is the bottleneck. Attack speed +5 adds offence.

Glass Cannon: +25% percent damage (30 to 55) for -3 armor (9 to 6). Plan weights favour damage (6.5) over armor (7), and the run is at full HP at wave 14, so kill speed is worth more. Stick is melee, off-plan. Bean Teacher costs lifesteal.
Crit chance is the only offered stat the plan weights (4.5). Elemental has no elemental weapons, melee is off-plan for a ranged build, and engineering is unweighted. Crit is the best fit.

Medal adds max HP, percent damage, armor and speed, all plan-weighted; its crit penalty is small. Frozen Heart and Flamethrower are elemental/fire, off-plan. Shotgun_1 is a weak duplicate with six weapons already held.

Clockwork Wasp adds +5 speed, which the plan weights and which helps kiting. Its structure bonus is mostly wasted, but the speed is worth the 127 gold. Onion would double the -5 luck. Taser is weak and off-set.

Sad Tomato's +8 HP regen (5 to 13) gives sustained healing across the wave, which helps the fragile mid-game. The cost is starting each wave at 50% HP. The regen should recover most of it, but the risk is real, so confidence is moderate.
Free crate item with no stat penalties. Garden adds consumable/structure value, which supports survival. Run is healthy at 112/112 with near-zero damage taken. No HP drain interaction to worry about.
Harvesting is already 48, above the plan's cap of 40, so option 1 is out. Plan weights attack speed (7) above crit (4.5). Range is unweighted in the plan. Attack speed +5 is the plan's best fit.

Acid: +8 max HP outweighs -2 dodge under plan weights (max_hp 7, dodge 3). Affordable at 391 gold. Blunderbuss blocked by 6-weapon cap and off-plan; duct tape nets negative (-2 max HP); lightning shiv is melee.

Reinforced Steel adds ranged damage and engineering, which the plan weights, at a speed cost. Missile adds +10% percent damage, which is strong with 64 percent damage. Both are affordable together. Hammer is melee and off-plan. Revolver has no weapon slot, since all 6 are full.

Knot adds +15 max HP and +15% percent damage, the best survival and damage gain offered. Weapons are already at the 6-weapon cap, so the lock costs little. Fuel Tank and Goat Skull hurt ranged damage or add melee; Turret is off-plan.

Sharp Bullet costs -5% percent damage, which is a negative on a build already relying on kill speed. Its piercing gain is offset by -20% piercing damage and -3 knockback. Declining is the safer choice.

No offer fits. Weapon slots are full at 6, so the Lute and Scissors cannot be added without a merge. Tyler is off-plan and costly. Weird Ghost sets HP to 1 at the start of the next wave, and past runs died around wave 19. Skip the visit.
